name: SS TANK - 250 LITER
summary: The 250 Litre Stainless Steel (SS) Water Storage Tank is a durable and hygienic solution for storing clean water. Made from premium food-grade stainless steel, it resists rust, corrosion, and contamination while preserving water quality.
intro: The 250 Litre Stainless Steel (SS) Water Storage Tank is a durable and hygienic solution for storing clean water in residential, commercial, and industrial applications. Manufactured from high-quality food-grade stainless steel, the tank is designed to resist rust, corrosion, and contamination, ensuring that stored water remains safe, fresh, and odor-free. Its robust construction provides excellent strength and long service life, making it an ideal alternative to conventional plastic storage tanks. With a 250-litre capacity, this tank is suitable for homes, apartments, offices, restaurants, hospitals, schools, and small commercial establishments. The smooth stainless steel surface minimizes the buildup of algae, bacteria, and sediments, making cleaning and maintenance simple. Its leak-proof welded construction ensures reliable performance, while the polished finish enhances durability and complements modern installations. Designed for long-term performance, the 250 Litre SS Tank withstands varying weather conditions and maintains the quality of stored water without affecting its taste or odor. Whether used for drinking water, domestic water storage, or commercial applications, it provides a safe, hygienic, and dependable water storage solution.
